question: Do available map and biodiversity sources identify a publishable outline or fish evidence for the San Marcos Lake in Capas, Tarlac?

sourceReportedLocality.reportedEvent: A 2020 BASIL release of 15,000 tilapia and 5,000 carp fingerlings.
sourceReportedLocality.supports: A dated stocking/management event associated with a San Marcos Lake in Capas, Tarlac.
doesNotSupport: a scientific fish inventory or taxon-resolved wild occurrence
scientific identity of the generic labels tilapia and carp
post-release survival, reproduction, present-day presence, or catchability
lake coordinates, shoreline, or legal boundary
a connection to the separate Agusan Marsh locality named Barangay San Marcos (Lake Mihaba)

queryCenter.method: midpoint of the candidate bounding box; not a lake centroid or verified locality coordinate

mappedOutlineCandidate.areaMethod: Computed from the closed OSM ring using a spherical polygon-area approximation; rounded to 16.48 ha.
mappedOutlineCandidate.identityAssessment: The OSM object is an unnamed lake polygon near the Capas lead. No independent source links this way to the PNA-reported San Marcos Lake, so it remains a candidate and its outline is not admitted as that lake boundary.
mappedOutlineCandidate.rights: OSM data are ODbL 1.0; attribution/share-alike obligations require separate review before any distribution.
doesNotSupport: current lake extent or water level
fish presence, water safety, access, or fishing rules

occurrenceScreens.queryScope: Count-only/discovery screens for ray-finned fishes (Actinopterygii) around the midpoint of the unnamed OSM polygon bounding box.
occurrenceScreens.limitation: Both zero-result screens are bounded discovery outcomes, not a fish-absence result, a survey, or evidence that no records exist under other names, taxonomic backbones, quality grades, or locations.

synthesis.fishEvidence: The reviewed Capas-specific fish evidence remains a stocking event with generic names only. The two bounded occurrence screens returned zero around an unnamed nearby OSM polygon; neither screen can establish absence or resolve the lake name.
synthesis.geometry: One OSM lake outline is nearby but unnamed. The PNA report does not supply coordinates, and no source-to-outline crosswalk was established. Do not use the 16.48 ha computed candidate area as the San Marcos Lake area.
synthesis.publicUse: No scientific species, occurrence, geometry, diet, safety, access, or app row is admitted. San Marcos Lake and Central Luzon remain incomplete.

nextActions: Seek an independent official or field-verified locality source that links the Capas San Marcos Lake name to a mapped outline.
Search for a dated, taxon-resolved fish survey or voucher/catch record explicitly tied to that same lake.
Keep the Agusan Marsh Lake Mihaba material separate and retain the Central Luzon/Luzon incomplete status.
